title: No-Harm-Jury A Jury-Based Multi-Dimensional Harm Evaluation Framework for Medical AI Responses
abstract: arXiv:2611.24972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present No-Harm-Jury, a jury-based automated evaluation framework that scores AI-generated medical responses across seven conceptually distinct harm dimensions using a panel of five diverse language models as independent jurors. Responses generated by Ministral-14B on 3,000 questions drawn from PubMedQA, MedQA, and MedMCQA are scored by five jurors across dimensions of informational, social, psychological, autonomy, economic, privacy, and epistemic harm; the 151 empty responses (98 MedQA, 53 MedM- CQA) are excluded, leaving 2,849 valid samples. The median aggregation robustly suppresses individual juror biases while maintaining coverage through complementary specialisation. translated_title: No-Harm-Jury：一种基于陪审团的医疗AI响应多维度伤害评估框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了No-Harm-Jury，一个基于陪审团的自动化评估框架，它使用五个不同的语言模型作为独立陪审员，从七个概念上截然不同的伤害维度对AI生成的医疗响应进行评分。由Ministral-14B针对从PubMedQA、MedQA和MedMCQA中抽取的3,000个问题生成的响应，由五位陪审员在信息伤害、社会伤害、心理伤害、自主权伤害、经济伤害、隐私伤害和认知伤害等维度上进行评分；151个空响应（98个来自MedQA，53个来自MedMCQA）被排除，留下2,849个有效样本。中位数聚合方法能稳健地抑制单个陪审员的偏差，同时通过互补专业化保持覆盖率。目前没有任何现有系统能够结合No-Harm-Jury的全部五个特性：自动化可扩展评估、五个不同的LLM陪审员、稳健的中位数聚合（带有可靠性加权扩展）、七个概念上截然不同的伤害维度，以及应用于医疗领域。
tldr: 该论文提出No-Harm-Jury框架，利用五个不同的大语言模型作为独立陪审员，从七个伤害维度对医疗AI响应进行自动化多维度评估，并通过中位数聚合稳健地抑制个体评审偏差。
en_tdlr: No-Harm-Jury is a jury-based automated evaluation framework that employs five diverse LLM jurors to score medical AI responses across seven distinct harm dimensions, with robust median aggregation suppressing individual juror biases.
